claims: Six-uniform target witness has continuous density with p_Q(0)=2*pi-7/3>pi.
Any finite universal target constant must satisfy C>=3*sqrt(2).

new_mathematics: For rank-three A=R Lambda R^T with R^T R=I_3, sum over coordinate triples I of |det A_I| equals |det Lambda|.
For A_m=diag(J_m/m,J_m/m,-J_m/m), exactly m^3 coordinate triples are nonsingular, each with determinant -m^-3; all other principal triples are singular.

Applying the completed account04/B18 Schur-pivot theorem to every nonsingular triple of A_m gives the best one-triple bound 2*sqrt(pi)*m, proving that this one-triple closure mechanism cannot be dimension-free on the full target.
unresolved_implication: Convert conserved aggregate rank-three determinant/cross-block mass into a dimension-free density or small-ball estimate before inverse determinant powers are paid, while handling mixed leverage and additional spectral directions.
next_step: Attempt an aggregate-minor randomized partition inequality on rank-three mixed-leverage frames, then test whether the argument survives arbitrary within-block quadratic terms and extra eigenvalues.
